source_note: Unlike Mexico or the Philippines, India's FSSAI does require large chains to disclose something: Rule 2.4.6 of the Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations, 2011 (as amended), effective January 1, 2022, requires food service establishments with a central license or 10+ outlets to display calorie (kcal) values per serving on menu cards/boards. It does not require carbs, protein, fat, or glycemic index -- those remain undisclosed by the chains themselves. Real India-market menu item names (McAloo Tikki, McSpicy Paneer, Chicken Maharaja Mac are India-specific items not sold in the US). No restaurant in this list publishes a full carbs/protein/glycemic-index breakdown (FSSAI doesn't require it), so nutrition figures here are AI-estimated from real ingredients and standard preparation for each item, the same approach the app's AI Food Scan feature uses. Menu item names are real, pulled from the chain's own menu.
